This is a pain question, so it's one for a doctor or physio, not me. I won't assess the knee or tell you what it probably is.

I can still keep the training side moving. Tell me what you want to avoid, and I'll build the replacement for Bulgarian split squats around that. I'll hold off on suggesting a specific swap until you've told me what to steer clear of. If you'd like, I can also check what's in your current program so we know what that session looks like.
